category_title: Seniors who avoid writing tasks due to perceived difficulty and lack of process knowledge
minimal_context: The student is participating in a 60-second Mind Dump word game to practice vocabulary fluency for their research.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start our Mind Dump game. I've written today's word on the board, and you have 60 seconds to write down as many words or phrases that come to mind related to it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just staring at the blank page. It is hard to get my ideas into words when I write.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just write down whatever you can think of.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I thought of something using humor, but I'm not going to write it down. I feel like I always have to throw away my creative traits to fit into an expected mold created by the school system.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We still have some time left on the clock. Keep trying to write something.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm done. I'm discouraged by obstacles to achievement like this. I feel pressured to find value only in my ability to produce what you want, so I'm just giving up.

task.content: Playing a word game, Mind Dump, once a week to teach fluency and flexibility with the vocabulary relevant to their individual research and writing.
task.learning_goal: teach fluency and flexibility with the vocabulary relevant to their individual research and writing

context.materials: word the teacher or student wrote on the board that day
context.social_setting: classroom environment in which students felt respected, appreciated, and valued

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Responding to Likert scale survey items regarding the difficulty of translating ideas into written words.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: bury their creative instincts to fit into an expected mold created by the school system
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: believing it is difficult to express themselves in writing, It is hard to get my ideas into words when I write.

behavior_patterns.condition: General behavior of marginalized students suppressing creative instincts to conform to school expectations.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: throw away creative traits like humor and symbolism
